note: The data model of the Everything Ecosystem: every record type, the layer that owns it, its schema, where its records live and what it references. No one schema holds everything; this file names them all and how they connect. packages/naive/src/checks/check-data-model.mjs fails when a JSON file in the repo has no record type here (or no ignore entry), when a schema file is unnamed, or when a kit claims a record of another layer. packages/naive/src/records/validate.mjs reads it to validate every record. Levels: method (this repo, the method's own records), workspace (one per builder), venture (inside a venture folder). Kinds (record, log, derived) tell a host how to commit each file in a venture: a record type's kind defaults to record, and files names the venture files no record type covers.

records.note: A workspace calendar: owner, members, visibility. Created with the workspace (default.json, named Venture); packages/naive/src/engine/calendar.mjs (Torian, 2026-10-30)
A founder as a person of the workspace, before any venture: opaque id, handle, ventures by role, profile only the founder confirms. packages/naive/src/engine/founders.ts (Torian, 2026-10-31)
An idea owned by a person, verbatim, at people/<person-id>/ideas/ (EE-114; founders/<handle>/ideas/ until the founders folder moves); a venture cites the idea it grew from
A work that forms the founder (book, podcast, film, essay), CSL-JSON field names, stored once at founder scope and cited by id
A person who inspires the founder and what invokes their zeal; a private person is opaque
The founder's real name, contact, puzzle and secrets, private: true, so they never reach a model or a release

One JSCalendar-shaped event (RFC 8984) per file. Derived events (decisions with a due time, releases) are a view in packages/naive/src/engine/calendar.mjs, never stored; naive calendar export writes .ics
The root record of a venture. It names the profile but does not contain it

The founder's words in venture.json: mission (core.promise), competence (core.competence), tagline (brand.tagline) and the chosen lifecycle_playbook. A view of the venture record: a write touches only these fields, so id, name, parent, phase, owner and status stay out of reach. Only a person writes it, and each write confirms only the statements it names
The venture's story and thesis in prose, beside venture.json
A named party the venture keeps a record for: client, customer, user, member or partner (EE-021). Optional

The end the venture exists to reach: statement, end state, measures, owner outcome, exit criteria per phase (EE-023). Since foundation 0.5.0 a framework for thinking (frameworks/telos): the telos-to-goals migration splits it into canonical goals and exit criteria and archives it; the route still reads, rendered from them

A canonical goal: statement, kind, horizon, measures with targets, owner. Framework-neutral: the telos, ambition tiers and other frameworks for thinking write goals through their maps_to (Torian, 2026-10-30)
A canonical requirement derived from goals or measures, by a phase, constraining functions, verified by a check, evidence or a person (the decision index's Requirements)
A phase's canonical exit criteria, each serving a goal measure; the lifecycle gate reads these (packages/naive/src/engine/lifecycle.mjs)
What the venture must not do, whatever framework states its goals
A framework for thinking (telos, ambition tiers, OKRs): vocabulary, frames, a template and maps_to into canonical records; it never changes the schema (packages/naive/src/engine/check-frameworks.mjs)
The founder's raw idea dump: every idea about the venture, verbatim and unprompted. Never rewritten by an agent (EE-059)

The idea dump mapped onto Naive's conventions: one <Idea> per idea, its text unchanged, tagged with departments, records and whether it exists (packages/naive/src/functions/strategy/frameworks/idea-map); drawn as a mind map (EE-059)

The idea map as a Merkle DAG: each idea with the ideas it builds on, a hash over its text and theirs, its signal, and its lane (in order or on its own); laid out left to right by dependency and top down by signal (EE-060)

The problem sub-score of validation: the claim and its cited evidence, each item graded (EE-026). Shares packages/naive/src/records/validation-evidence.schema.json with every sub-score Gated like the telos (EE-050): the problem statement is a founder-critical record, so an agent's write is a draft the founder accepts.

One problem interview in the validation study: an anonymised person, consent, the transcript's raw source, bottlenecks, current solutions, the chosen problem, a prediction with Naive and without, and the follow-up that checks it. Names stay in _private.

A beta tester's answers at one checkpoint, with where the feedback was routed and how (Jev or the fallback). The beta gate unlocks the next capability once it exists (packages/naive/src/engine/beta-gate.mjs).
Validation sub-score: how it solves the problem and the evidence people choose it (EE-026)
Validation sub-score: retention cohorts, Ellis survey and evidence that a segment keeps using it (EE-026)
Validation sub-score: price model, points, buyer and evidence they pay (EE-026)
Validation sub-score: path, motion, channels and evidence a channel works; the path sets the weights (EE-026)
Validation sub-score: skills needed, held and the gaps; cofounder sought (EE-026)
Validation sub-score: per MAD tier evidence; grades as the weakest tier (EE-026)
Validation score weights and floors by go-to-market path and venture kind (EE-026), version 0.x
Phases, gates and questions of Product Anatomy; self-describing, checked by its runner's tests

A step-by-step guide a venture function runs in conversation with the founder; run by packages/naive/src/interfaces/skills/run-playbook (a template is one record's empty shape; a playbook is the order of the work)
The library of founder-profile attributes (puzzles, passions, telos, ambitions, strengths, weaknesses ...) with their types, and the templates a profile starts from
The tags an idea map may use: departments, records, pillars and the exists judgment, with the threshold (EE-059); checked by the idea-map runner
Scores per product per question; the matrix is rendered from them
Product Anatomy input for one product with parts (venture, core, products, flows), such as Naive or Mentura; read by packages/naive/src/functions/products/frameworks/product-anatomy/anatomy.mjs
A decision log. The schema's own is EE-NNN; a venture keeps its own log under its knowledge layer

One live decision, in a decisions/ folder beside the record it decides, with its parent, boundary (fail closed or open) and the phase it is needed in (EE-054, EE-057); node packages/naive/src/engine/decisions.mjs renders the matrix. The decision log keeps the history

The impact map of a merged decision version: per function, the records that depend on what changed, which were marked stale, and the follow-up decisions proposed (packages/naive/src/engine/impact.mjs)

Whether each concept of the Next.js translation ledger is built, with evidence and the docs page that explains it; checked by packages/naive/src/checks/check-nextjs-status.mjs, which writes the What's built page
Domain, product, experience, interface and systems design documents; which ones a venture needs is in the design-documents registry

Which source each record type lives in: the venture's own folder by default, or a connected source such as a GitHub repository (EE-037); its rules are the source-of-truth matrix: a system of record and owner per record type, attribute and context (EE-042)
For each fact kept once in its system of record, every place that repeats it; live children must show the parent's value (EE-042)

Default freshness profiles by record type (Revalidating V-2): stale, revalidate and expire after Next.js cacheLife, plus per_phase and live; a venture overrides them under freshness in naive.config.json

What software work exists, after ISO/IEC/IEEE 12207 (R-26): processes, activities and tasks with the decisions each task needs, the phase it is first needed in, its owning role and the venture function it belongs to. No execution detail: MAD routes how, the agent router picks who. MAD's method-request names a task as <mad_module>/<activity>/<task>.
On-demand revalidations (a tag, a path or a package marked stale), checks that a record is still right, and phase changes: one append-only line each (Revalidating V-1, V-5, V-7)
The departments a venture can import: APQC categories tagged with Porter's value chain, with need-now priors (EE-047)

The default operating-rules module. A venture's operating-rules.json merges over it. The membership gate reads rejection.retry. Parent-only edits, self-fix approval, gates before a design, the Jev layer, the design-diff verb set, question routing, impact tiers, standing rules, SPRT loss, signals, time to detect, suspension, notifications and the Lean requirement are declared for later pull requests. The Wilson z and tier thresholds, and the SPRT rates p0, p1, alpha and beta, are provisional, pending Lean proofs. The SPRT statistic is floored at 0
The tag in each department folder, in the governance or operations layer; an optional primary/ or support/ grouping folder is for looking at only (EE-047)

Canonical nouns; follows the metamodel packages/naive/src/records/ontology-metamodel.schema.json, checked by packages/naive/src/checks/check-nouns.mjs, rendered to packages/naive/src/terms/ontology.md. Each noun names its function (or null) and whether it can type a handoff package

The catalog of ontologies (N-050): every name@function scope with its version, owner, status and imports, one per function. Acyclic imports and defined-or-imported terms are checked by packages/naive/src/terms/catalog-test.ts

Torian's ruling on one field (status, importance, relation or scope) of one idea record, citing exactly one source, Torian's GitHub comment URL or the decision card he tapped (ontology program S3-PR2). Only Torian's rulings enter docs/reviews/ontology-golden/; scripts/golden-ruling-test.ts checks each is named <idea>.<field>.json and names an idea that exists

Each layer keeps the sources behind its defaults; filled by packages/naive/src/functions/capabilities/skills/find-reference; a kit inside a layer keeps its own at <layer>/kits/<kit>/references/references.json
Each layer's tools; interfaces must reach at least four layers
Vocabulary: St. Gallen 55 plus named extras
Starting layers by phase, read by init-venture
This file

A layer manifest (was a kit manifest): skills, record types the layer still owns, record types it reads and writes, checks. The file is <layer>/layer.json (EE-071). Venture packages are packages/naive/library/packages/<name>/package.json. A kit is Mentura's and lives in the app that installs it.
Execution folded into operations (EE-038).

Time spent in the venture on one day from transcript timestamps alone: sessions, active minutes, messages, estimated tokens in, in the venture's time zone; internal by default (naive activity, TRANSCRIPT_DIAGNOSIS_V2)
Days since last touch and the streak, for the docket; a long silence is a gentle nudge (naive activity --write)
Append-only results of running checks
Self-describing; which design documents a venture needs at which phase
Raw outputs kept as evidence for a benchmark write-up beside them
Roles and their tiers; shape used, no schema yet
The product, brand and business pillars: teams, roles and deliverables. The template holds the guides; a venture holds one-line stubs that link to them
The cap table: share classes and their rights, holders, grants with vesting, option pool, SAFEs and notes (EE-022)
Formal and advisory boards, their seats and reserved matters
What founders agreed: roles, commitment, IP, departure, deadlock; prose beside it
Exit paths kept open and sale values to model; payouts computed by payouts.mjs
Where the venture publishes and who may publish what there: channels, guidelines, checks, preview and approvers; every publication passes this gate (EE-025)

Patterns that mark internal text (decision ids, attributions, record paths, codenames, phase jargon, draft markers); public output matches none of them (packages/naive/src/engine/check-leaks.mjs). Naive's defaults in packages/naive/src/engine/internal-terms.json, the founder's own in the venture's governance/internal-terms.json

Every place the venture has published: channel, artifact, url, the sha256 of the built output that is live, the person who approved it, when, earlier versions and any embargo. naive publish writes it; packages/naive/src/engine/check-publications.mjs checks it

The marketing matrix: the audiences a public site speaks to, what each needs to learn and from which record, where it belongs, and how prominent it must be by need; weighted by whether the venture is raising, hiring or inviting contributors, and by its ICPs (EE-062). Version 0.x, unevaluated
How present the venture's public records are on its marketing site, item by item, with a score weighed by who the site must speak to now (EE-062)

The planned public site: each page's sections in order, with the MDX component, the need, the audience and why, when it shows, the internal record it draws on and the public variant to write; part of the marketing package handed to engineering (EE-064, EE-065)

Public variants of internal records, written by marketing agents as their own MDX: each names the record it is a variant of, its audience, whether it is published and who approved it; checked by the public gate (EE-064)
Need-now priors per venture record type and phase, with conditions that raise or lower them (EE-028)

Venture packages (EE-067, EE-069): the assumed governance model; core packages by department (each record's one home, what it reads, priors per phase with conditions, what completion unlocks); handoff packages by receiver; record-level dependencies; the question matrix

The decision library: one recurring venture problem as a shape (goal, hidden decisions, premises and the attacks on them, a freshness spec, reasoning), never an answer. packages/naive/src/engine/frames.mjs matches it to the founder's words, judges its premises against the venture and proposes its decisions, open

The venture package view (EE-067, EE-069): the open core packages and handoffs, each record confirmed, to review or to write, what moves now and what waits, with its versions; the records themselves stay in place

A release (C-11, I-17): the venture's static shell, written by node packages/naive/src/router/orchestration/build-release.mjs. release.json is the manifest (confirmed records frozen in with their sha256, date and who confirmed them; named live holes; the route table as the release holds it; frozen command answers); card.json is the release card's data (P-25, O-7). The frozen copies under .release/records/ keep their own record types. Read without the router by node packages/naive/src/engine/start-release.mjs
Who the venture needs, agent or person, when, with what authority, and where a human stays in the loop; recruiting briefs for open person roles (EE-029)
What agents can, cannot, may not or are not known to do, with sources and dates (EE-029)

Who or what wrote each record, how, from what and under which decision: one append-only line per write, hash-chained, after W3C PROV (EE-031). A handoff package's membership gate writes <id>.provenance.jsonl beside the package; the line's sha256 is the package body's, so gates need not run in order, and the same gate on the same body is written once

One step of an agent run (an agent or subagent, a model call, a tool call, a router call, a judgment or a trigger), one line per span in traces/<session>.jsonl, after the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions; hash-chained like provenance. A provenance line made inside a span names it, so what changed points to the step that changed it. Holds names, routes, sizes, times and tokens; inputs and outputs only when the venture turns on traces.content

The venture's overrides to Naive's defaults (P-2, like next.config.js): the gate's static rules, function owners, check settings, thresholds, which System 1 questions run, pinned package versions and how strictly the acting role is checked. An agent's write of it is a draft, since it can loosen the gate
Old routes kept as aliases of their new ones, so a rename does not break agents (EE-032)

What runs Naive on a platform or in an agent harness (Z-4): the entry files a harness adapter writes into a venture and where it loads skills, or the tests a platform adapter runs. A platform's adapter lives in the app that hosts Naive and is passed in with NAIVE_PLATFORM_ADAPTER. Verified when it passes the framework's tests (packages/naive/src/interfaces/adapters.mjs verify)
Naive's versions with their guides, the migrations between them, and each package's version and channel (U-1 to U-6, EE-076). naive upgrade reads it from the installed copy

A Mentura kit (EE-071): an enhanced package or command, with its automations (triggers that need a complete package, M-12) or its agent workflow (the agent-run upgrade, U-3). Kits live in the app that installs them, which points the framework at them with NAIVE_KITS; this repository has none. The framework reads a kit as data and never imports its code (packages/naive/src/engine/kits.mjs)

Who the venture serves: one record per ideal customer profile, each with its own id, exactly one primary (EE-051); a foundation statement, gated. The older single foundation/icp.json is split by the icp-profiles migration
How the venture's products and agents must behave: principles with a source and a check (EE-053); a foundation statement, gated
The map of strategic foundation by the Five Ws and How plus whether (EE-051)
A customer master record. Activity is an append-only stream. The package is never complete (EE-070).
An investor master record. Activity is an append-only stream. The package is never complete (EE-070).
A money master record. Activity is an append-only stream. The package is never complete (EE-070).
Cash, monthly flows and runway from the money source's last sync; versioned, and the only money record a model sees (EE-070)
Declares one append-only stream and whether it is sensitive (EE-070).
Where a founder-supplied source came from. Raw is immutable (EE-070).

A view built from records for a reader (document, deck, dashboard, design, page, file, site), naming the records it read; artifacts are what get published, records never are. packages/naive/src/engine/check-artifacts.mjs flags one stale when a record it cites changes
The text of a raw source. original.* stays out of git (EE-070).

The typed output of one model step (use model, EE-073): what it read, its answer and confidence, and whether code accepted, overruled or routed it to a person as uncertain. The agent's until a person confirms it (packages/naive/src/router/orchestration/model-steps.mjs)
The venture types create-venture scaffolds, and what each starts with (EE-082)
Roles a person can hold in a venture, beside the agent roles (EE-082)
One role a venture can install: function, grantable decision classes, default tier, lint suites, verifier (never itself) and skill

One yes or no call made on evidence, after signal detection theory: its question, impact tier, the sensor that scores it, the criterion, the costs of the four outcomes (from the tier unless a person set others), the base rate and who resolves it. A one_way_door detector draws no line and sends every call to a person. Governance owns it because it says how decisions are made. A person accepts any change to its criterion (docs/design/SIGNAL_DETECTION_2026-11-07.md)

The detection ledger beside each detector: one append-only line per call (score, criterion in force, call) and one per resolution (hit, miss, false alarm or correct rejection), hash-chained like provenance. Rates, sensitivity and ROC area are computed from it
The venture's people: role and hats per person; venture.json for human capital (EE-082)
One file per founder, linked to the founder agreement (EE-082)
A fund's thesis (EE-082)
A fund's terms and closes (EE-082)
A company in a fund's pipeline (EE-082)
The systems of record create-venture offers per function (EE-083)
A package's own terms, at glossary/<package>.json (Y-2): local to the package unless exported, so an agent in another package sees only exported terms; glossary/terms shows what one package sees

The design system in the marketing package: the ethos read from the strategic foundation and every brand choice with why and the records it rests on (mission, ICP profiles, market, founders), inherited through marketing/design-system/inputs. The values stay in marketing/brand.json

Brand tokens in the marketing package (Y-3): colors, licensed self-hosted typefaces (T-1), the font each role uses with scopes where nearer context wins (Y-5, T-2), voice rules (the global stylesheet for words), the logo and marks (P-24) and outside design systems by reference (Y-4). Read by every agent's layout; marketing/brand/tokens renders it for interfaces

The register of what the venture ships as it is, in public/ (I-23, J-2, J-3, J-4): each file's source, license and credit, facts code reads from its bytes, alt text and who wrote it; remote images as links with a note in raw/; the hosts an agent may fetch from
One defect: title, severity P0 to P3, status, the version it was found and fixed in, and how to reproduce it. Stable means no open P0 or P1 (naive bugs, packages/naive/src/engine/bugs.mjs).

Opt-in usage events shared by the plugin beta and Mentura: which capability ran, when, how long, how it ended; no record contents, no _private paths, the venture id hashed with a per-venture salt (packages/naive/src/engine/telemetry.mjs). Not routed: the router never routes .naive/, so events stay off MCP and the API.
The plugin beta's capabilities in unlock order, each with its checkpoint feedback form (packages/naive/src/engine/beta-gate.mjs).

A decision roadmap: an ordered set of frames, each step with its phase, dependencies, door and decider. packages/naive/src/engine/roadmaps.mjs installs it by proposing each step's decisions open; packages/naive/src/engine/check-roadmap.mjs rejects cycles, unknown frames, steps with no decider and one-way doors delegated away from the founder

A lifecycle playbook: an ordering of the venture development lifecycle, with the gate and the evidence that clears each phase. A venture names one in venture.json lifecycle_playbook (default product-first); packages/naive/src/engine/lifecycle.mjs reads its gate evidence
Public seed list of terms for the term-harvest skill to run through the term engine (Grokbot handoff, 2026-11-01); public terms only, never a founder glossary

One kind of signal, the component of a signal library: props, the parts it composes, how it folds into records (projects, from six fixed reducers), a default age bound and worked cases. A library ships it at types/<id>/<version>.signal.json; a Naive package ships open types under signals/types/, as the implicit library naive (signal library design, everything-ecosystem docs/design/SIGNAL_LIBRARY_2026-11-06.md)

One immutable, dated, content-addressed and rated signal, at signals/<type>/<subject>/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<id>.json in a library. A venture's local library is raw/signals/, so a signal a person emits sits at raw/signals/signals/...; it is written once and never edited, and a correction is a new signal that retracts or supersedes it (signal library design, everything-ecosystem docs/design/SIGNAL_LIBRARY_2026-11-06.md)
A signal library's append-only day index, log/<type>/<yyyy-mm-dd>.jsonl: one line per signal published that day, so a pull reads only the days after its cursor

library.json at a signal library's root: its id, title, publisher, license and the layout contract naive-signal-library@1. It lists no types. A library is read in place as a source with carries signals; it lives outside the venture, so only the example is in this repository
A person's master record for one competitor (Porter 1980). The signal projector may create it once from a signal's organization part and never writes it again
What signals say about one competitor, rendered by the signal projector from the signals salient for it. Only the projector writes it; a person corrects it by emitting a superseding signal

A function's research program, programs/<function>.md: the person-edited instructions its researcher (the <function>-researcher role) reads, one section per pattern it works (autoresearch design, everything-ecosystem docs/design/AUTORESEARCH_RECORDS_2026-11-06.md, program.md per function). Prose a person owns, written whole: only a person writes it (writer person), and the router refuses every agent, a researcher included. The starter is packages/naive/src/functions/<function>/templates/research-program.md, copied in once when the venture lists the function in venture.json departments and the file is missing (packages/naive/src/engine/research-programs.mjs); the copy is then the founder's

The code that makes every record at one projected route pattern: one pure TypeScript module, <pattern>.recipe.ts beside the records it makes, run only in the sandbox (packages/naive/src/engine/recipes/sandbox.ts). The source is TypeScript, so its form is typescript and its schema governs only what it exports (hears and knobs), as the sandbox reads them; packages/naive/src/records/validate.mjs never reads the file. A path segment [id] is literal: competitors/[id]/signals.recipe.ts makes every competitors/<id>/signals.json (autoresearch design, everything-ecosystem docs/design/AUTORESEARCH_RECORDS_2026-11-06.md)

A frozen version of how one recipe is scored, <pattern>.plan.json beside it: as-of points per window (training, dev, holdout), horizon and gap, read cut, weights, min_gain and the budgets of dev evaluations and holdout checks, addressed by its sha. A person makes it with naive recipes plan, which freezes its eval set at <venture>/_eval/<sha>/

A recipe's experiment log, <pattern>.experiments.jsonl beside it: one line per write of the recipe (keep, discard or fail, with the dev score and its standard error) and one per holdout check (pass or fail), hash-chained like provenance and written by the evaluator only. A plan's spent budget is counted from it

Every signal a recipe heard for one record, <record>.reception.json beside it: salient or noise, the reasons a noise reception failed, the signal's valid, transaction and withdrawal times, the engine's bitemporal factors and later a hindsight label (helpful, inert or harmful, with the recipe's sha). Only the projector writes it

Types written by naive typegen from the route table and the MCP tools
A staged upgrade's copy of the venture (packages/naive/src/engine/upgrades.mjs), discarded or landed
Published frameworks built from the venture's folder (packages/naive/src/engine/user-frameworks.mjs)
Rank history of the decision index, one line per re-score
Failed trigger runs, one line each (packages/naive/src/router/orchestration/triggers.mjs)
Each publish lint run's findings (packages/naive/src/engine/publish-lint.mjs)
Instrumentation events when instrumentation is on (packages/naive/src/core/instrumentation.mjs)

The blob store: the bytes each provenance line names, under their SHA-256 (packages/naive/src/core/blobs.mjs). Content-addressed and never changed, so it is committed like a record; an as-of read (packages/naive/src/store/as-of.mjs) needs it and cannot rebuild it

A recipe's frozen eval set, <venture>/_eval/<sha>/eval-set.json, written by naive recipes plan (packages/naive/src/engine/recipes/eval-set.ts): the as-of points, the frozen signal index, each fact's versions and the settled outcomes. It cannot be rebuilt (a library that backfills later must not leak into it), so a host commits it whole; it never changes once frozen, so a base check can only pass. The router never serves it. Its files must not take a path a log record type names
The trigger cursor and every run's state; not rebuildable, so kept whole
The plugin beta's unlock state per tester (packages/naive/src/engine/beta-gate.mjs)
What the harness adapters wrote, so an upgrade never overwrites a file it did not write
Summaries marked stale when a source changed (packages/naive/src/engine/stale.mjs)
How far the telemetry log has been sent
The per-venture salt that hashes the venture id in telemetry; never sent
Keeps .naive/ out of git
